lines.text: Oops! A big glass of dark red grape juice tipped over onto the cream carpet!
Leo looked around in panic and shouted, Mom, baby Maya bumped into the table!
Little Maya tilted her head with big sad tears—she didn't understand why!
Leo watched his little sister cry, and a heavy gray cloud rained over his thoughts!
Blaming someone innocent makes an accident ten times worse than the spill itself!
Leo took a deep breath, walked to Mom, and said, I lied. It was my elbow!
Mom hugged Leo and Maya tightly: Accidents happen, but owning up takes real strength!
Together they grabbed towels and cleaned the rug until it sparkled clean!
